EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Labor Allocations
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance Support. I will be happy to provide instructions for assigning labor allocations within your Time and Attendance system:
Select the desired employee's name from the employee drop-down menu.
Navigate to Employee Maintenance > Employee Assignments > Labor Allocations.
To add a new entry, click the ADD button at the bottom of the page.
A pop-up window will appear, allowing you to select the desired settings.
Once all fields are filled, click the SAVE button in the pop-up window.
You will see a line with this information appear in the employee's Labor Allocations page. Repeat this process for each allocation needed. **Keep in mind that the allocation percentages should always total 100%.**
To edit any previous entries, click on the pencil icon to the right of the allocation entry.
A pop-up window will appear, allowing you to make the necessary edits to the percentage of time you would like allocated to the desired organization level item.
Click the SAVE button to commit the changes.
Repeat this process as necessary to adjust the percentage assigned to other organization level items. **Keep in mind that the allocation percentages should always total 100%.**
Once you've assigned the appropriate labor allocations to the employee, you can navigate to Daily Procedures > Total Hours and change the Display view to "Summary by Org Level > whichever level to which you are allocating". You will see the hours being divided according to what you've assigned.
Please keep in mind that the Labor Allocations feature is enabled for the following pay groups at this time:
PAY GROUP NAME
PAY GROUP NAME
Therefore, an employee must be assigned to one of the above pay groups in order for the allocations to calculate as expected. Pay groups are assigned via the Employee Maintenance > Employee Assignments > Groups > Pay Group tab. If you need labor allocations to be configured for other pay groups going forward, please let us know and we will be happy to help.
If you have additional questions or concerns, please let us know and we will be happy to help.
Thank you,
